title: Self-designing UI deep-dive
ev: "You ask." - typed prompt: "Who is waiting on a reply?"
"It builds the screen." - WAITING ON YOU card, 3 people (Leo, Tomas, Mia)
USER: "Draft all three."
RESHAPE: one card splits into 3 draft cards - "Talk, and it reshapes."
USER: "Send them." - cards collapse into a Sent pill ("Send. It disappears.")
Title: "Interfaces, built the moment you ask."
USER: "How is the raise going?"
Empty card shell appears first (skeleton)
Number counts up: $1.15M > $1.40M committed, 70 percent bar, 4 investor tiles
JARVIS: "70 percent committed."
JARVIS: "But one lead has gone quiet." - chip: 1 lead gone quiet
USER: "Who?"
MORPH: card dissolves into particles
Particles reassemble into the investor pipeline board; Fernhill Capital highlighted
RESHAPE into a person card: Nadia Brooks, Fernhill - $500K, Diligence, asks Retention
USER: "Get me on her calendar." - Find time card, Tue 2:00 held
USER: "Prep me." - card flips in 3D
Brief: Fernhill Capital - bullet rows stream in, with source chips
JARVIS: "She asked for retention numbers."
RESHAPE into an email draft: Q3 update: retention
JARVIS: "Send her the update?" (approval)
USER: "Add the cohort chart." - chart draws into the email
USER: "Send it." - card shrinks into pill: Sent - Nadia Brooks
Fade out; end card "Interfaces that shape themselves."
